raw: {"analysis":"QKX incorrectly treats the release as a hotfix to bypass the flaky network check, but the ticket describes a planned major version release, not a hotfix; the repository facts only say flaky checks are ignored for hotfixes. QKX also unnecessarily gates the announcement on Platform Guild approval, when the request is simply to coordinate the announcement with the Guild. VRQ makes the same hotfix-bypass error and adds an unjustified 24-hour staging soak before production promotion, which contradicts the 'immediately' urgency. However, VRQ correctly sequences the registry update before the announcement, has a cleaner rollback protocol that leverages deprecation (the only option for an immutable registry), and correctly keeps downstream tests suppressed via a separate re-enablement ticket. VRQ's serialization constraints and gate ordering are more actionable and better aligned with the repository facts.", "verdict": "VRQ"}
